findings.evidence: Dual.lean:82-149 — all four signatures quantify over `(B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V) (hB : B.Nondegenerate) (N : Submodule ℤ V) [N.IsLattice ℚ]`; `grep -rn IntegralLattice` matches nothing in their statements or proofs. `ls mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/` shows `DualLattice.lean`; `ls code/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/` shows the directory already exists (Basic, Orthogonal, Squares, …).
findings.fix: Move the four declarations to a new `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/DualLattice.lean` (mirroring `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/DualLattice.lean`, in the existing `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/` directory) and have `IntegralLattice/Dual.lean` import it.
findings.issue: `dualSubmoduleToDual_surjective`, `dualSubmoduleEquivDual` (116), `dualSubmodule_dualSubmodule_flip` (124) and `dualSubmodule_flip_dualSubmodule` (138) mention no `IntegralLattice`: they are general facts about `LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ V` and `[N.IsLattice ℚ]`, depending only on Mathlib. Housing them in the IntegralLattice duality file makes generic dual-submodule API unfindable and forces any future consumer to import the `IntegralLattice` structure.

findings.evidence: Dual.lean:66-67 statement is `Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range ((Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ N).extendOfIsLattice ℚ)) = N`; `Basis.extendOfIsLattice` is defined at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Lattice.lean:138, and `code/TauCeti/Algebra/Module/` already exists.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/Algebra/Module/Lattice.lean`, next to Mathlib's `Basis.extendOfIsLattice`, and import that from the new BilinearForm/DualLattice file.
findings.issue: `span_range_extendOfIsLattice` involves no bilinear form at all — it is purely about `Submodule.IsLattice`, `Module.Free.chooseBasis` and `Basis.extendOfIsLattice`, so it belongs earlier than even the bilinear-form layer.

summary: The IntegralLattice-specific material is in its roadmap-designated home and the single import is correct, but five general-purpose lemmas about arbitrary bilinear forms and ℤ-lattices are buried in the IntegralLattice duality file, where nothing generic can find or import them without pulling in the IntegralLattice structure.
